description: The wind and temperature at an altitude and a time from the winds-aloft grid's columns at a place, one column an hour (AWC's GFA levels, an altitude MSL under 18,000 ft and a flight level from FL180, 14 CFR 71.33; each level's wind as its east and north parts, kt): each hour's column read at the altitude as a station's levels are (the direction the short way round, the speed and temperature linear in altitude, clamped past the ends, the temperature keeping its difference from a standard day; FAA-H-8083-28B 27.2.1.1.1), then the two hours round the time weighed by how near each is, the nearest hour's outside them. A level with no wind (under the ground) is left out. Null where the grid has none. A list for "altitudes".

valid_s.description: The hour the column is valid at, UNIX seconds.

u_kt.description: The wind's east part, toward where it blows.

v_kt.description: The wind's north part, toward where it blows.

at_s.description: The time read at, UNIX seconds.
